beats.say: Domestic cats purr at a steady frequency of 20 to 30 vibrations per second.
No cat on the entire planet can both purr and roar at the same time.
The snow leopard is the fifth felid species with an incompletely ossified hyoid that purrs.
Cheetahs also purred with an average frequency of 20.87 Hz during egressive phases.
That means domestic cats purr at a steady frequency of 20 to 30 vibrations per second.

meta.title: Match Day #1: Why do cats purr
meta.summary: Domestic cats purr at a specific frequency, while no cat can both purr and roar.
meta.comment: Did you know cats purr at that exact frequency?
facts: Domestic cats purr at a frequency of 20 to 30 vibrations per second.
No cat can both purr and roar.
The snow leopard is the fifth felid species with an incompletely ossified hyoid that purrs.
Cheetahs purred with an average frequency of 20.87 Hz during egressive phases and 18.32 Hz during ingressive phases.
